_about: What a normal run logs. scripts/run_report.py marks anything not listed here as NEW. Values are labels; add one only after reading the run that showed it. Seeded 26 Oct 2026 from the 424 logs under build/run and the player runs (docs/GENERIC_GUARDS_2026-10-26.md).

bloom_refusals.5: continuity: a job that cannot chain to the last accepted one (restart bootstraps since 24 Oct)
bloom_refusals.6: contract: the render-target pool's layout changed (rebuild renews since 24 Oct)
bloom_refusals.12: packet: the tracked packet refused the job (see packet_refusals)

missing_hooks.sharpen: TAA: the game runs no sharpen pass (docs/TAA_STEREO.md)
missing_hooks.sdk_evaluate: TAA: the game makes no DLSS evaluation (docs/TAA_STEREO.md)

fallback_reasons.stopped: owned stereo stopped: flat game on the panel
fallback_reasons.suspended: owned stereo suspended: flat game on the panel
fallback_reasons.waiting: no stereo pair for 500 ms: flat game on the panel (loads, title, readiness blocks)

masks.0x800: hub: the walkable Battle Barge, the main menu, a load

packet_refusals.4: left eye's current camera fields differ from the native builder (level loads, cutscene starts): recoverable
packet_refusals.9: SDK: the private DLSS eye refused the frame (a poisoned private context)
packet_refusals.12: entries no longer hold the producer's tracked pose: recoverable
packet_refusals.13: tracked math refuses the inputs: recoverable

readiness_reasons.cutscene: cutscene: every job ready, no player needed
readiness_reasons.job: no job or an old job
readiness_reasons.menu: a menu over a rendered world: stand down for the panel
readiness_reasons.owner_changed: the player's owner changed: settle again
readiness_reasons.ready: three jobs with the same owner
readiness_reasons.settling: fewer than three jobs with the same owner
readiness_reasons.world_invalid: the pose's world transform is invalid

scene_modes.cutscene: the game's cutscene flag, no loading screen
scene_modes.hub: the walkable Battle Barge, the main menu or a load (0x800 without a menu over it)
scene_modes.screen_menu: a full-screen menu over a rendered world (UI coverage)
scene_modes.title: startup screens, the title and its dialogs (0x1000)
scene_modes.unknown: a mask the classifier has no rule for

warning_kinds.CallCensus: a hook doubled or missing in stereo (the hook is NEW in doubled_hooks/missing_hooks until triaged)
warning_kinds.OrdinaryBloomRenewed: the pool was rebuilt and the owned pair renewed (reused=true: a retired pair made for that layout is current again)
warning_kinds.OrdinaryClockGap: a gap in the frame clock
warning_kinds.OrdinaryHeadsetColdRestart: an unknown refusal restarted stereo from scratch
warning_kinds.OrdinaryHeadsetRestarted: a camera cut bootstrapped the chain
warning_kinds.StereoStall: readiness blocked on the player in plain play: the probes re-learn the level (a verdict only at action=give_up)
warning_kinds.SceneMode: a mask the classifier has no rule for, or a bit no rule reads (the mask is NEW too unless already in the table)
